text.title: xUnit Testing Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema for the test-plan manifest this methodology produces. Validator enforces required keys + per-field constraints.

example.code: { "test_project": "Billing.Tests", "framework": "xunit", "test_classes": [ {"name": "InvoiceServiceTests", "layer": "unit", "fact_count": 12, "fixture": "none", "all_async_return_task": true, "uses_fluent_assertions": true, "uses_moq": true, "methods": [ {"name": "Create_ValidDraft_ReturnsInvoiceDto", "kind": "Fact", "returns": "Task"}, {"name": "Create_NonPositiveTotal_Throws", "kind": "Theory", "returns": "Task"} ]}, {"name": "InvoicesApiTests", "layer": "integration", "fact_count": 8, "fixture": "class", "all_async_return_task": true, "uses_fluent_assertions": true, "uses_moq": false, "methods": [{"name": "Get_ExistingId_Returns200", "kind": "Fact", "returns": "Task"}]}, {"name": "InvoiceRepositoryTests", "layer": "data", "fact_count": 5, "fixture": "collection", "all_async_return_task": true, "uses_fluent_assertions": true, "uses_moq": false, "methods": [{"name": "List_TwoPages_ReturnsSecondPage", "kind": "Fact", "returns": "Task"}]} ], "coverage": {"line": 78.4, "branch": 65.2, "gate_enforced_in_ci": true}, "uses_testcontainers": true, "uses_webapplicationfactory": true, "forbidden_patterns_found": [] }

example.note: project name does not end in `Tests`; framework wrong; an integration class with no fixture, an `async void` method, a name that is not `Method_State_Expected`, and no FluentAssertions; coverage below gate; Testcontainers + WAF off; forbidden Thread.Sleep present.

list.item: `UseInMemoryDatabase` in tests that exercise queries, constraints, or migrations.
Shared mutable state on a static field across tests.
`Assert.Equal(expected, actual)` where actual is a collection or POCO.
Duplicated `[Fact]` methods that differ only by input, where a `[Theory]` belongs.
`It.IsAny<T>()` in a `Setup` whose argument the test does care about, or a mock with no `Verify`.
`Program` left internal while the test project references `WebApplicationFactory<Program>`.
